solution.summary: In this paper, we propose a new deep architecture for fusing camera and LiDAR sensors for 3D object detection. To address this problem, we propose a method called 3D-CVF that combines the camera and LiDAR features using the cross-view spatial feature fusion strategy.
solution.approach: In this paper, we propose a new deep architecture for fusing camera and LiDAR sensors for 3D object detection.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose a new deep architecture for fusing camera and LiDAR sensors for 3D object detection.
To address this problem, we propose a method called 3D-CVF that combines the camera and LiDAR features using the cross-view spatial feature fusion strategy.

In this paper, we propose a new 3D object detection method, named 3Dcross view fusion (3D-CVF), which can fuse the spatial feature maps separately extracted from the camera and LiDAR data, effectively.

experiments.summary: Our evaluation, conducted on the KITTI and nuScenes 3D object detection datasets, demonstrates that the camera-LiDAR fusion offers significant performance gain over the LiDAR-only baseline and that the proposed 3D-CVF achieves state-of-the-art performance in the KITTI benchmark.

evidence.quote: Our evaluation, conducted on the KITTI and nuScenes 3D object detection datasets, demonstrates that the camera-LiDAR fusion offers significant performance gain over the LiDAR-only baseline and that the proposed 3D-CVF achieves state-of-the-art performance in the KITTI benchmark.
Also, we show that the proposed 3D-CVF method achieves impressive detection accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art performance in KITTI 3D object detection benchmark.

limitations.summary: Although the performance of the LiDAR only based 3D object detectors have been significantly improved lately, LiDAR point clouds are still limited for providing dense and rich information on the objects such as their fine-grained shape, colors, and textures.
items: Although the performance of the LiDAR only based 3D object detectors have been significantly improved lately, LiDAR point clouds are still limited for providing dense and rich information on the objects such as their fine-grained shape, colors, and textures.
Since the joint camera-LiDAR feature map does not contain sufficient spatial information, both the multi-scale LiDAR features and camera features are extracted using 3D RoI-based pooling.
